data.name: Charvi
data.gender_notes: Charvi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Charvi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'charu', which means 'beauty' or 'charm'. The suffix 'vi' means 'radiance' or 'shining'. This name represents the joy, happiness, and radiance that a newborn brings into the world. The name Charvi carries the meaning “Joy, Happiness, Radiance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Charvi usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, happiness, radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Charvi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joy, Happiness, Radiance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charvi total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Charvi reflects the Indian tradition of naming children based on auspicious and meaningful words. In this case, the name embodies the inherent beauty and charm that is believed to be present in every individual. Charvi is also a unique and beautiful name that can be proudly shared with others, contributing to the rich cultural diversity of the world.
data.spiritual_significance: Charvi is more than just a beautiful name. Its spiritual significance lies in the belief that each person is a unique manifestation of the divine. The name Charvi reminds us that every individual has a radiant and beautiful inner self, just like the shining light within a star. It is a reminder to see and honor the beauty and worth of every person, regardless of their outer appearance or circumstances.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Charvi: Radiant and pure like the crystal clear waters of a sacred pond, Charvi embodies the divine energy of knowledge and wisdom. Her name signifies the inner illumination and spiritual growth that comes from seeking and acquiring true knowledge.

vedic_reference.note: This name does not have a direct Vedic reference.

historical_references.reference: Charvi was an important queen of the Satavahana dynasty, reigning from around 130 CE to 150 CE. She is known for her military prowess and is often depicted on coins alongside her husband, Gautamiputra Satakarni.
The name Charvi is also mentioned in the epic Mahabharata, where she is described as the wife of Bhishma Pitamaha and the mother of Vidura. The story takes place before the great Kurukshetra war.
historical_references.time_period: Unknown (but before 3100 BCE, the estimated date of the Mahabharata)

It is commonly seen on social media platforms where people share the meaning and significance of different names. Lastly, the name Charvi has been featured in Bollywood and Indian cinema, adding to its appeal and recognition.
